parent_objective: audit M1417 structural source pass with invasiveness gate failure before retuning or outcome probing
blocked_by: M1417 passes source and warmup evidence gates but misses matched/bucketed collision-share and clear-row gates
supersedes: running outcome probe directly from M1417 despite failed invasiveness gate

public_gates: M1418 must audit M1417 structural pass and invasiveness failure
M1418 must decide outcome probe, warmup-gate retune, branch synthesis, or stop
M1418 must not run outcome interventions, train, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, export a training corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim self-identification from source materialization
do not ignore the matched/bucketed invasiveness gate failure

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M1417 repaired source smoke and decides whether a focused warmup-gate invasiveness retune is justified
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no source smoke, outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if source materialization is treated as self-ID evidence
stop if failed invasiveness gates are ignored
stop if audit routes directly to training or corpus export
stop if actor input changes are proposed
fallback_plan: admit a focused warmup-gate invasiveness retune if M1417 source and warmup evidence are otherwise strong
route to branch synthesis if another retune would be a narrow loop
stop or pivot if no non-overfit retune is credible

admission_evidence: M1417 structurally passed with 1630 source rows and 250 matched/bucketed rows
M1417 missed matched/bucketed collision-share and clear-row gates
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one follow-up manifest if audit admits it

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1418 is a source-result audit and cannot claim history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit source materialization and warmup evidence
decide whether outcome probing is allowed
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1417 no-training repaired source smoke artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If invasiveness gates fail, record that and retune or synthesize before outcome probing.
allowed_claims: M1417 source-result audit and next-route decision
no source smoke, outcome intervention, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1417 source materialization is strong enough to justify a focused warmup-gate invasiveness retune before outcome probing.
success_criteria: audit records M1417 source diversity, warmup evidence, and invasiveness metrics
audit chooses outcome probe, retune, synthesis, stop, or pivot without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: audit treats M1417 source materialization as self-ID evidence
audit ignores the invasiveness gate failure
audit routes directly to training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or claim expansion
decision_rule: M1418 passes if it classifies M1417 into an explicit non-training next route.
